lines.zh: 我一步一步地压着沙走。
lines.en: I press my way across the sand, step by step.
This shell of mine is heavy.

lines.zh: 我六条腿轮流撑住地面。
lines.en: Six legs take turns holding the ground.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方沙都陷下去。
lines.en: The sand sinks where I've passed.
I work my way around the dune.
I push the sand ahead of me.

lines.zh: 我的头很低，几乎蹭着地。
lines.en: My head rides low, almost touching.

lines.zh: 我的背上有厚厚的一层。
lines.en: There's a thick layer on my back.
I scrape past a stone.
I shift forward another half foot.

lines.zh: 我走起来像块会动的石头。
lines.en: I move like a walking boulder.

lines.zh: 我一路上都没有停下来。
lines.en: I haven't stopped once the whole way.

lines.zh: 我的腿在沙里陷得很深。
lines.en: My legs sink deep in the sand.
I shake the sand off my back.
Fine lines run across my plates.
I'm listening under the sand.
My pincers rest on the ground.
I haven't shifted from this spot.
Wind blows sand into my seams.
I draw my legs in a little.
The swarm's scent comes from over there.
I lower my pincers slowly.

lines.zh: 我一动不动地守着这片沙。
lines.en: I hold this sand without moving.
You look small beside me.

lines.zh: 我从沙里抬起头，望着你。
lines.en: I lift my head from the sand and stare.
My shell protects me well.

lines.zh: 你敲我一下也没什么用。
lines.en: Knocking on me won't do much.
I'm watching what you'll do.
I push my pincers forward.
You shouldn't stand on the sand.

lines.zh: 沙漠底下，虫群全是我们的。
lines.en: The underdesert belongs to our swarm.
Back off and I won't follow.
There's no soft spot on me.
A seam opens in my shell.

lines.zh: 挨了一下，我停半步又走。
lines.en: Struck — I pause half a step and plod on.
Fluid seeps from the seam.
I draw my legs in to shield my belly.
I don't even grunt.

lines.zh: 我的壳厚得能顶住子弹。
lines.en: My shell could stop a bullet.
Limping, I still crawl.
I turn my head slowly toward you.
I don't lower my head at all.
I push it aside with a pincer.
I don't even pause.
There's no smell to it.
If you're giving, give something big.
I cover it with sand.
One glance at you, then my head lowers.

lines.zh: 沙子里没有吃的，你身上有吗？
lines.en: There's nothing to eat in the sand — do you have any?
Hitting this shell is wasted effort.

lines.zh: 我的甲把你的力气吃掉了。
lines.en: My shell takes the force.
I turn a little and walk on.
That didn't turn me aside.
Sand slides off me.
I reset my feet.
I watch you from within my plates.

lines.zh: 沙虫的甲壳，撞上也不响。
lines.en: The sand bug's shell doesn't ring when struck.
I shift forward another half step.
Her shell is thicker even than mine.
The two of us crawl side by side.
My pincers touch hers.
We stop below the dune.
Her back markings differ from mine.

lines.zh: 沙丘后面，我们只是靠着。
lines.en: Behind the dune, we simply lean together.
She goes east, I go west.
We each push the sand aside.
This is enough for both of us.
At night the sand is full of movement.

lines.zh: 我的钳子把它举到面前。
lines.en: My pincers lift it before my face.
It crushes in my grip.
I bring it to my mouth.
This much is no use.

lines.zh: 我用前肢把它按进沙里。
lines.en: I press it into the sand with my forelimbs.
It slips through my pincers.
I hold it up against the sun.
It wouldn't stop anything.
I drop it behind me.
The sand covers it quickly.
Both pincers are open.
I swing my body that way.
You've climbed onto a stone.
My shell doesn't fear what you carry.
I press in step by step.
I mean to hit first.
You've lowered your stance.
Then come and hit me.
However far you go back, I follow.
I block the way with my body.

lines.zh: 我这么大，影子先压到你。
lines.en: I'm so large my shadow reaches you first.
You go round the side; I turn too.
I'm slow, and I don't stop.
I lower myself, shell edge forward.
So I crash into you.
I push the sand up in a ridge.
Rock wall behind you — no retreat.
I drive my whole shell into you.
This shove sends you back.
Your blow doesn't break my shell.
Head low, I butt again.
You're knocked onto the sand.
My whole shell bears down on you.
You can't move under me.
I shift my body off slowly.
An hollow is left in the sand.
A hole opens in the sand's surface.
My back plates come out first.

lines.zh: 我把六条腿一根根撑开。
lines.en: I brace all six legs out.

lines.zh: 我从沙里拱出来，抬头看。
lines.en: I heave out of the sand and look up.
The swarm holds this stretch.
I try one step.

lines.zh: 沙漠的沙在动，是虫群来了。
lines.en: The desert sand stirs — the swarm has come.

lines.zh: 外壳够硬，才配在沙暴里走。
lines.en: Only a shell this hard walks in a sandstorm.

lines.zh: 我摔下来，把沙砸出一个坑。
lines.en: I fall and punch a hollow in the sand.
Water rises over my back plates.

lines.zh: 冲击把我掀翻，甲上冒烟。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over, my shell smoking.

lines.zh: 一根尖物卡进我的甲缝。
lines.en: Something sticks fast in a seam.

lines.zh: 那道光让我的腿僵住了。
lines.en: The light locks my legs.
Too starved to lift a leg.

lines.zh: 雷击在我甲上，我抖得很厉害。
lines.en: Lightning hits my shell and I shake hard.

lines.zh: 下面没有沙，我一直往下。
lines.en: No sand below; I keep going down.
